senses.en: develop or come from sth. else
examples: This word is [[derived]] from Latin, meaning "water."
Medically, we will [[derive]] great benefit from the application of this technique.

senses.zh: 得到，获得（优势或愉快的感受）
senses.en: vt.get sth., esp. an advantage or a pleasant feeling, from sth.
examples: This word is [[derived]] from Latin, meaning "water."
Medically, we will [[derive]] great benefit from the application of this technique.

senses.en: make sb. feel sexually excited
examples: His strange behavior at the meeting yesterday [[aroused]] my suspicion.

senses.en: make sb. have a particular feeling or attitude
examples: His strange behavior at the meeting yesterday [[aroused]] my suspicion.

senses.en: consisting of or relating to the cells of plants or animals
examples: Researchers have been observing the course of the disease at the cellular level.

senses.zh: （计算机屏幕上显示准备接受指令的）提示， 提示符
examples: The computer program will [[prompt]] the user to enter data where it is required.

senses.zh: 引起，激起（某人说或做某事）
senses.en: vt.make people say or do sth. as a reaction
examples: The computer program will [[prompt]] the user to enter data where it is required.

senses.en: an instruction to a computer to do sth.
examples: Check that the computer has executed the [[commands]] that you typed in.
An officer stood on one of the tanks and began shouting [[commands]] through a loudspeaker.

senses.en: an order that should be obeyed
examples: Check that the computer has executed the [[commands]] that you typed in.
An officer stood on one of the tanks and began shouting [[commands]] through a loudspeaker.

senses.en: (fml.) sb. who receives sth.
examples: I felt glad that I was a giver of pleasure, not merely a passive [[recipient]].

senses.en: the movement of blood around your body
examples: Stretching is a good way to relax muscles and to increase blood [[circulation]] during long-time air travel.

senses.en: eat too much, or eat more than is healthy
examples: A woman who [[overeats]] during pregnancy can cause health problems for her child.

senses.en: over a wide area
examples: One weakness of the essay is that the information is given diffusely instead of in a certain section, thereby reducing the effective communication of ideas.

senses.zh: 缓慢的；迟缓的；懒洋洋的
senses.en: moving, reacting or working more slowly than normal and in a way that seems lazy
examples: The company has been rather [[sluggish]] in responding to the rapid changes in technology.

senses.en: (not before noun) not knowing about or not noticing sth. that is happening around you
examples: He went on and on about how successful he was, [[oblivious]] to the fact that he had hurt her.

senses.en: increase or improve sth. and make it more successful
examples: They won the semi-final and this [[boosted]] the morale (士气) of the team.

senses.en: (also adrenalin)
existing or popular for only a short time
examples: Many words appearing during that period were quite [[ephemeral]] and have passed into history.

senses.en: make inactive
examples: Researchers have identified antibodies (抗体) that [[inactivate]] the virus before it has the chance to change itself.

senses.en: sb. / sth. that is not included in a general statement or does not follow a rule or pattern
examples: Few guitarists can sing as well as they can play; however, he is an [[exception]].

senses.zh: 继续留存（较惯常或理想的时间长）
senses.en: continue to exist, be noticeable, etc. for longer than is usual or desirable
examples: The faint smell of her perfume [[lingered]] on in the room long after she had left.

senses.zh: 预测的； 预言的；前瞻的
senses.en: (usu. before noun) (fml.) relating to the ability to show what is going to happen in the future
examples: Newton's physical theories are a good example of how a scientific theory may be [[predictive]] as well as explanatory.

senses.zh: （一段时间）在中间的；到一半（的）
senses.en: when half a period of time has passed
examples: She was interrupted by the chairperson when she was [[midway]] through her presentation.
We are coming close to the [[midway]] point between Los Angeles and San Francisco.

senses.zh: 在中途（的）；在半路（的）；在中间（的）
senses.en: between two places, and the same distance from each of them
examples: She was interrupted by the chairperson when she was [[midway]] through her presentation.
We are coming close to the [[midway]] point between Los Angeles and San Francisco.

senses.en: a feeling of excitement about sth. enjoyable that is going to happen in the near future
examples: There was a sense of [[anticipation]] in the audience as the curtain went up for the play.

senses.zh: 引发，激发（尤指一系列事件）
senses.en: make sth. happen very quickly, esp. a series of events
examples: There must be specific events which [[triggered]] the aggressive displays in your dog.

senses.en: the process of digesting food
examples: [[Digestion]] is the organic process by which food is converted into substances that can be absorbed into the body.

senses.en: (AmE tumor)
sb.'s height or size
examples: I was by no means short in [[stature]], but next to this man I felt like a dwarf (矮子).
At that time there were no other universities in England equal in [[stature]] to Oxford and Cambridge.

senses.en: the degree to which sb. is admired or regarded as important
examples: I was by no means short in [[stature]], but next to this man I felt like a dwarf (矮子).
At that time there were no other universities in England equal in [[stature]] to Oxford and Cambridge.

senses.zh: （大量液体）汹涌；（电流）浪涌；（化学物等）突然涌动
senses.en: if a large amount of a liquid, electricity, chemical, etc. surges, it moves very quickly and suddenly
examples: Adrenaline [[surged]] through her veins.
After the doors of the theater opened, the crowd [[surged]] forward and police had to intervene.

senses.en: suddenly move very quickly in a particular direction
examples: Adrenaline [[surged]] through her veins.
After the doors of the theater opened, the crowd [[surged]] forward and police had to intervene.

senses.zh: 而（用于强调两种情况之间的差异）
senses.en: used for emphasizing the difference between two situations
examples: Stress can be extremely damaging to your health. Exercise, [[meanwhile]], can reduce its effects.
The hurricane will reach the island this evening. [[Meanwhile]], residents are being evacuated (转移).

senses.en: while sth. else is happening
examples: Stress can be extremely damaging to your health. Exercise, [[meanwhile]], can reduce its effects.
The hurricane will reach the island this evening. [[Meanwhile]], residents are being evacuated (转移).

senses.zh: 抑制（生长、发展、起作用等）
senses.en: prevent sth. from growing or developing, or from working effectively
examples: It is probable that the medication will [[suppress]] the symptom without treating the condition.
Illegal cross-border transactions are very active in this area despite international attempts to [[suppress]] them.

senses.zh: （凭借武力或严格的法律）平定，制止，镇压
senses.en: stop opposition or protest using military force or strict laws
examples: It is probable that the medication will [[suppress]] the symptom without treating the condition.
Illegal cross-border transactions are very active in this area despite international attempts to [[suppress]] them.

senses.en: (infml.) pass liquid waste from your body
examples: I need to [[pee]] before I leave. It's going to be a long journey.

senses.en: do sth. because of another person's advice or order, or because you have received information or had an idea
examples: A patient will usually listen to the doctor's advice and [[act]] on it.

senses.zh: 补足；将···增加到所需之量
senses.en: increase the level of sth. slightly so as to bring it back to the level you want
examples: He had to do extra jobs on the weekend to [[top]] up his income and support the family.

senses.en: write your final message at the end of an informal letter
examples: It's getting late, so she wrote a few more lines and [[signed]] off with "Yours, Janet."

senses.zh: 欧内斯特 • 斯塔林（英国生理学家）
沃达丰（世界著名的跨国移动通讯网络公司）
弗雷德里克 • 马丁尼（人名）
一款“阅后即焚”的信息分享应用程序
